title: hedyotis nigricans var. scabra
intro: Hedyotis nigricans var. scabra, commonly known as Chinese hedyotis, is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing fever, relieving sore throats, and promoting wound healing. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral effects, which contribute to its traditional uses. The bioactive constituents of Hedyotis nigricans var. scabra include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
